notes:
Summary: evaluation for ultra-low-latency inference for market-signal and trade decisioning. Primary ask = sub-30ms P99 for 1-2k concurrent connections during market hours; cost-sensitive (target blended cost <$0.0009/token for L2 models).

Recent timeline:
- 2025-11-20: intro demo w/ Avery — walked through Redwood hosted api + dedicated overview. client: liked routing/fallback idea.
- 2026-01-10: POC kickoff (engineering + infra). Scope: 2-week perf baseline on their models (Llama 3 13B, Falcon variants) on A10G and H100.
- 2026-02-02: benchmark request submitted (INF-4123). Asked for: P50/P95/P99 latency, tokens/sec, cost per 1M tokens at several batching configs.
- 2026-02-18: security questionnaire returned (SOC2 evidence + SSO). Security flagged PCI/data-retention questions; asked for KMS workflow.
- 2026-03-01: perf findings call (ff_20260210_7712) — Redwood team suggested continuous batching with adaptive window and prefix KV caching for chat-like prompts. Client requested Optimize recommendations tuned to their request distribution (short prompts, frequent repeats).

Use-case details / constraints (shorthand):
- Workload = mix: 65% short chat-ish queries (10-30 tokens), 25% rerank of candidate lists (50-150 tokens), 10% longer analysis. Bursty: market open/close spikes x3 baseline QPS.
- SLOs: P99 <= 30ms for routing-critical paths; soft P99 <= 60ms for non-critical. Throughput target during bursts = ~200 qps sustained, 800 qps short burst.
- Cost target: want dedicated/reserved pricing to hit ARR target; request quantization options (4-bit / int8) to reduce units. Concern about quality drop w/ aggressive quantization on financial prompts.
- Perf asks: run comparisons across kernels/hw, end-to-end latency (network + runtime), impact of batching sizes on P99, KV cache hit rate improvement, suggested cache TTL, cold-start penalties. Also want mixing of small-message streaming vs. full-response batching.
- Routing: prefer smart routing by latency then cost (primary latency), auto-fallback to smaller/quantized variants when capacity constrained.

POC deliverables requested from Redwood:
- Benchmark matrix: H100 vs A10G at batch sizes {1,4,8,16} for Llama3-13B and Falcon-40B-instruct-8bit; P50/P95/P99, cost per 1M tokens.
- Optimize profile: batching TTLs, cache keys for prefix reuse, quantization profile recommendations with sample prompts to validate.
- Security appendix: KMS integration flow, audit log retention options, VPC peering checklist.
- Playbook: rollback/fallback policy for degraded perf during spikes.

Quoted from CTO on 2026-02-02 call: "We can't tolerate >40ms P99 on our trading signals — latency is revenue. But if quantization drops signal quality we lose too much alpha."

Sales notes / approach:
- Champion = head of infra (met twice). Finance wants ARR banding before committing dedicated nodes. Recommend small reserved pod + burst policy.
- Value props to emphasize: Redwood Optimize suggestions (immediate cost wins), transparent per-token perf/cost dashboards, dedicated SLA with regional placement, and runtime fallback to preserve SLOs.

Next operational steps (short):

- SE (Jordan) to produce baseline config + scripts; ask client to provide 200 representative prompt samples and tokenization script.
- Book security deep-dive 60m with SEC-ops (Lena + Avery) week of 2026-03-22.

- Exact residency: prefer NA but want EU copy for EU traders; multiregion routing cost implications.
- Budget timing: procurement cycles end of Q2; close dependent on benchmark outcomes.

Attachments / refs: pricing deck link above, security_FAQ pdf, benchmark ticket INF-4123.
